claims.value: LenR channel per raw = "Resistent line SILAC label" column; WT = the other channel
claims.evidence: Deposited MMLenalidomideResistantfiledescription.csv gives, per raw file, the local experiment name, fraction (tryptic / PNGase F) and "Resistent line SILAC label" (Light for *H* names, Heavy for *L* names). Paper SILAC-CSC: Len sensitive and resistant cells mixed 1:1, "performed in duplicate in both forward and reverse SILAC labeling scheme such that a total of four biological replicates". Data check under this map: CD33 log2 LenR/WT positive in all 8 H929 files (+1.1..+4.5) and in all 4 OPM2 PNG files (+0.5..+3.2), PTPRC positive in all 8 H929 files, matching paper Fig. (only CD33 and PTPRC/CD45 common increases) and SD6 (H929 CD33 +3.40); per-file sign agreement with SD6 proteins |log2|>1 is 12-71 agree vs 4-20 disagree in every one of the 16 files.

claims.value: <line>_<WT|LenR>_mix<1-4>; biological replicate = mixture 1-4 within each (cell line, phenotype) group
claims.evidence: Four SILAC mixtures per cell line: experiment 1 (2016 acquisitions, local names *_PNG1/*_tryp1) LenR-light (mix1) and LenR-heavy (mix2), experiment 3 (2017-02-10 acquisitions, *-PNG3/*-tryp3) LenR-light (mix3) and LenR-heavy (mix4). Paper: "a total of four biological replicates" (Fig. legend: n = 4 biological replicates; heavy and light channels swapped for two replicates each). Each source = one labelled cell population in one mixture.

claims.location: comment[data file], assay name, comment[fraction identifier] rows 1-32
claims.value: fraction 1 = tryptic peptides (skyline*tryp.csv), fraction 2 = PNGase F-released peptides (skyline*PNG.csv) of the same mixture
claims.evidence: The file description pairs one tryptic and one PNGase F raw per (line, experiment, orientation). Same-mixture pairing is supported by the shared per-mixture mixing offset (median log2 H/L tryp vs PNG: H929 mix1 -0.95/-1.28, mix2 -0.02/-0.18, mix3 -0.86/-0.66, mix4 +0.01/-0.02; OPM2 mix1 -0.18/-0.25, mix2 -0.36/-0.55, mix3 -0.24/-0.31, mix4 -0.51/-0.44). Macro CSC protocol: on-bead tryptic digestion of the neutravidin-captured surface glycoproteins; the PNGase F fraction carries N[+1] deamidation (deglycosylated sites). Each raw is listed in exactly one Skyline export.
One raw file per (mixture, fraction).

claims.evidence: Paper: "peptide mass tolerance was 6 ppm; fragment ion mass tolerance was 0.4 Da" (ProteinProspector search of the SILAC data).
Paper Macro-CSC: trypsin protease (Thermo 90057), 10 ug, overnight; search enzyme trypsin with up to two missed cleavages. PNGase F releases N-glycopeptides and is not a peptide cleavage agent.
Paper Macro-CSC digestion buffer: "1.5 M urea, 50 mM ABC, 10 mM 2-iodoacetamide, and 5 mM TCEP".
Raw headers of 4 files: "Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS", "Method of Q Exactive Plus"; paper: Q-Exactive Plus. PRIDE lists the generic Q Exactive (MS:1001911); the raw headers win.
Raw method: TopN 20; paper: "data-dependent mode using a top 20 method".

limitations: Partial scope: 16 of 63 deposited .raw files annotated (the SILAC lenalidomide-resistance arm). The 47 label-free runs (MaxQuant searches MM_Leukemia, PI_resistant, Small_Molecule; MM_surfaceome_sample_list.xlsx) are out of scope for this SILAC campaign and recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md: Q20180308-22, Q20180324-07, Q20180324-09, Q20180410-05, Q20180420-03, Q20180428-11, Q20180430-01, Q20180512-03, -05, -07, -09, -11, -13, Q20180720-04, -06, -08, -10, Q20180722-15, Q20180801-03, -05, Q20180810-10, -16, Q20180811-01, -03, -05, -07, -09, -11, -13, Q20180818-06, -08, Q20181215-03, -04, -05, -07, -09, Q20190113-04, -05, -07, -09, Q20190124-05, -07, -09, -11, Q20190125-03, -05, -07 (.raw).

Rule 14 (multiplex check): no MaxQuant search exists for the SILAC runs (searched in ProteinProspector, not deposited). SILAC multiplexing is verified from the deposited Skyline exports instead: every quantified precursor has light and heavy MS1 areas with 8.01 Da (K) / 10.01 Da (R) shifts. The three deposited MaxQuant summaries (Multiplicity 1) cover only the label-free runs.

Search parameters come from the paper text (ProteinProspector v5.13.2, 6 ppm / 0.4 Da) and the deposited Skyline modified sequences; no ProteinProspector parameter file was deposited. Acetyl (Protein N-term) and Deamidated (N, PNGase F fraction) are in the Skyline data but not in the paper text; the data were preferred.

Tryptic and PNGase F raws of one local experiment are taken as two fractions of one SILAC mixture (same source names). Supported by the file description pairing and the shared per-mixture H/L mixing offset; the paper text does not describe the PNGase F step for the SILAC arm explicitly ("subjected to the macro CSC protocol as described above to include all tryptic fragments").

Biological replicates 1-4 = the four mixtures (2 experiments x forward/reverse) as the paper calls them "four biological replicates"; whether forward and reverse mixtures of one experiment used independent cultures is not stated.

Global per-protein log2 LenR/WT correlations between forward and reverse files of one experiment are weakly negative (-0.29 to -0.51), i.e. a label-specific bias dominates the unregulated majority; the marker proteins (CD33, PTPRC) and SD6-significant proteins agree with the deposited map in all 16 files, so the map is kept.
The OPM-2 PNG mix2 raw Q20160815-17 has local name OPM2L_PNG1_2 (other three are _1); treated as the only deposited injection of that fraction.
characteristics[cellosaurus accession] uses the parental CVCL for the LenR derivatives (no Cellosaurus entry for in-vitro evolved lenalidomide-resistant H929/OPM-2).

characteristics[passage number] = not available (only "5 passages" in SILAC medium is stated, not a passage number); characteristics[cell type] = not available (not stated); cell source/biorepository of H929 and OPM-2 is not stated (vendors given only for RS4;11, MM.1S, AMO1, KMS12-PE, RPMI-8226), so the column is omitted.
